summary: Expanded universe focuses on execution chokepoints rather than reactor concept headlines: operating nuclear assets with hyperscaler PPAs, advanced-reactor developers with fuel/regulatory risk, nuclear-qualified components, pumps/valves, and domestic uranium feedstock.
